senses.gloss: --the sixth face of the fourteen faced God giving rise to विजय। वा. २६. ३८.

kinds of corn; व्रीहि (a kind of rice), यव (barley), गोधूमा (wheat), अणु (a small grain), तिल (sesamum seeds), प्रियङ्गु (long pepper: saffron), उदार (a sort of grain), कारुष (a kind of sesamum), वीती- नक माष (beans), मुद्ग (a kind of kidney-bean), मसूर (kind of pulse), निष्पाव (a kind of pulse), कुलुत्- थिक (horse gram) etc.
1: वा. 8. १५०; Vi. I. 6. २२-6.
[page१-286+ १५] Unsown and unploughed; १४ kinds; wild and good variety; when these got exhausted and the world was in a state of hunger and sadness, ब्रह्मा milked the earth with seeds; १७ good varieties except the १४; coming in of cultiva- tion and the name वार्ता; for names see the text.
2: Br. II. 7. १२६, १२८, १३८, १४८; Vi. I. 5. ५०.
Same as the lord of.
3: Br. II. १०. ६२.
--a city on the Himalayas. Br. IV. ३०. ९६.
--the moon as the lord of the plants. M. २३. १३.
--the wife of Bhava; son was उशनस्. वा. २७. ५०. [page१-287+ २३]
